name: ULIO.3D.STEAM
pre_gcode: M140 S{bed_temp}   ; p3d: need to heat the bed
M190 S{bed_temp}   ; p3d: wait for bed temperature
M109 S{temp}   ; wait for extruder temp
G28 W          ; home all without mesh bed level
post_gcode: M104 S0        ; turn off right extruder
M107           ; turn off filament cooling fan
G1 Z55 F{180}  ; drop bed G1 55 mm
G28 X0 Y0      ; home XY axes
